TC-20/S01.title: Hospital dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live (dev)
TC-20/S01.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 7/7. 51 Hospital rows (past the 50-row page; the shared account had no other rows): Total 51 = the stored rows, all 51 listed, no Nursing Home row. A row added by another client appears and Total / Pending go +1 within 0.3 s with the dashboard open, removing it takes it out again, no reload. Status changes cannot be written from outside on dev (no rounding:update on the allow list); the live status moves are judged through the app's own Generate / Complete in S09.
